Sarne's going to send out his troopers to gun them down if I tell where they're hiding out.|Doctor Akanseh and the resistance fighter, during his interrogation|<ref name="SI" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''resistance fighter''' was allied with a [[Kal'Shebbol resistance group|group]] that operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kal'Shebbol/Legends|Kal'Shebbol]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. He was captured by [[Moff Sarne's forces|forces]] loyal to the local [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]], [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]], and questioned by [[Akanseh]], a [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] who had been forced to work for the Moff as an interrogator and [[Torture/Legends|torturer]]. The resistance fighter refused to reveal the location of his friends, or their plans, despite the threat of pain being inflicted on his person in an effort to make him cooperate.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Try administering these, my friend&mdash;I'm sure we'll find this scoundrel's attitude changes rather quickly when he feels his blood boiling within his veins.|Moff Sarne, to Akanseh, referring to the resistance fighter|<ref name="SI" />}}
[[File:KalShebbol-TheDarkStryderCampaign.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The fighter was part of a resistance group on Kal'Shebbol.]]
During the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] was part of a [[Kal'Shebbol resistance group|resistance group]] based on [[Kal'Shebbol/Legends|Kal'Shebbol]], rebelling against [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]]'s rule of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. At some point, the resistance fighter was wounded and captured by the Moff's [[Moff Sarne's forces|forces]] and taken to a [[Detention area|detention block]] for interrogation. Restrained in a [[strap-chair]], the man met his interrogator, a [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] named [[Akanseh]]. Although Akanseh abhorred causing pain in others, the Moff forced him to use his medical techniques for interrogation against his will. Rather than [[Torture/Legends|torturing]] his charges, Akanseh attempted to gain their trust and persuade them to reveal their secrets to him. The resistance fighter had his wounds treated by Akanseh while the Mon Calamari implored him to reveal the location of his fellow rebels and their plans. The resistance fighter, however, would not reveal any information to Akanseh. He knew that if he revealed the location of his compatriots, the Moff would send his [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] to eliminate them.<ref name="SI" />

Sarne interrupted the interrogation, flanked by two guards, claiming to be performing a surprise inspection on Akanseh's skills. Akanseh once again tried to get the resistance fighter to reveal the location of his friends, noting that he could no longer guarantee that he would be unharmed. The man again refused to betray his fellow rebels. Sarne offered a [[hypo-syringe]] to Akanseh, stating that the resistance fighter would not be as stubborn once the [[Unidentified clear liquid|contents]] started to make his [[Blood/Legends|blood]] boil in his veins. When Akanseh visibly hesitated in administering the liquid, one of the Moff's guards produced a second hypo-syringe with the same contents. Sarne implied that if Akanseh failed to get the required information from the man, then he would have the doctor share his charge's pain, and that the concoction was vastly more potent on Mon Calamari physiology than it was on Human.<ref name="SI" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Blow off, fish-face. No way I'm betraying my friends.|The resistance fighter, to Akanseh|<ref name="SI" />}}
During his [[Time/Legends|time]] in Akanseh's care, the resistance fighter displayed a cocky and stubborn attitude, refusing to give away the location of his fellow resistance fighters, even when faced with the threat of torture. He openly defied his interrogator, Akanseh, insulting him to his face by referring to the Mon Calamari as "fish-face."<ref name="SI" />

==Behind the scenes==
The resistance fighter appeared in the short story "[[Spot Inspection]]," which was published in ''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]'', released by [[West End Games]] in [[1995]].<ref name="SI" />
